decisions.reason: The enclosed manual laser workstation line builds on core laser competence, and with growth and slack there is no performance shortfall to prompt problemistic search, though the new 2024 laser cabin may partly overlap it.
The thermal inkjet printer is close to the established coding portfolio, has its own page and costs little to maintain, so results meet aspirations in a growing industry.
The piezo inkjet printer complements the thermal model in the surface-matched, single-source offer, and expansion-level slack lets the firm carry it while results develop.
As the flagship laser marking line shown on the home page, it embodies the firm's strategic direction and is far from any drop consideration.
The newly launched compact laser cabin has its own page and extends the laser offer, and a one-year-old product with uncertain results is carried given ample slack.
The award-winning lubricant printing system exceeds aspirations as an external success signal and opens a niche in sheet metal processing, so the firm keeps it.
